description.short: Approve invoice receipts and see time-limit risks from Etyme.
description.full: Etyme writes to you in Teams when an invoice receipt needs your approval or a contractor is near the client's time limit. Each card shows the amount, the supplier, the contractor, the period and the rule. Approve, reject with a reason, or ask why. Every answer is recorded in Etyme under your name. Settings, investigation and reports stay in Etyme.

commands.title: What needs me
commands.description: Show the invoice receipts and time-limit risks waiting on you now.
